title: Puharich's legal pad: ELF emitter in his television

tellings.quote: installed this ELF uh emitter in his television set so when he would turn on the TV, he would get hit by this

plain: A researcher speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels describes notes on a legal pad written by Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, around 1994 and 1995. According to the researcher, Puharich wrote that someone had put an ELF emitter, a device sending out extremely low frequency radio waves, inside his television, so that whenever he turned it on he would be hit by those waves. If true, it would mean someone was secretly targeting him in his own home.
